quarterly_data.signal: Liquid cooling (company deck): TaiSol and NVIDIA are co-developing a 2.6 MW L2L CDU engineered for next-generation NVIDIA MGX platforms; the 2.6 MW in-row liquid cooling CDU supports 800 VDC architectures and is described as validated for reliable production (pressure, leak and thermal testing). The company says it is expanding from modules to high-power CDUs and rack-level liquid cooling integration; the deck shows in-row CDUs (L2L) of 200~500kW, in-rack CDUs (L2L) of 120~250 kW, an NVIDIA B300 inner manifold and CPU liquid cooling module, an NVIDIA R200 DIMM liquid cooling module and an AMD Instinct MI355 liquid cooling module (2 x AMD EPYC CPU, 8 x MI355 GPU).
